dimensions.assessment: Affects members of the Federal Reserve Board of Governors, congressional banking committees, and banking organizations with less than $17,000,000,000 in total assets.
dimensions.evidence: banking organizations supervised by the Board having less than $17,000,000,000 in total assets

dimensions.assessment: Administrative and governance changes within the Federal Reserve regarding the oversight and policy recommendations for community-sized banks.
dimensions.evidence: develop policy recommendations for the Board regarding supervision and regulation of banking organizations

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending or revenue changes are specified; adjustments are tied to nominal gross domestic product changes.
Amends the Federal Reserve Act and the Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council Act of 1978 to adjust responsibilities and oversight thresholds.
dimensions.evidence: Section 10 of the Federal Reserve Act is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory modifications to the Federal Reserve Act with ongoing annual GDP-based threshold adjustments.
dimensions.evidence: At the end of each year for which the nominal gross domestic product of the United States increases... the Board shall adjust each dollar figure

missing_information: Exact number of banking institutions that fall under the revised $17 billion threshold.
importance_detail.rationale: This bill specifies additional duties, reporting requirements, and asset threshold adjustments for the member of the Federal Reserve Board of Governors who has experience working in or supervising community banks.

card.summary: The Main Street Capital Access Act modifies and lessens various banking regulations, adjusts capitalization requirements and asset thresholds for community banks and holding companies, and alters federal bank supervision, merger reviews, and resolution procedures.
